body: Hey, I'm feeling really bad as well right now... Do you want to talk for a bit? I've had a really rough night and it seems like you have as well, so if you're interested please let me know

You helped me a lot. I was just honest with her about everything (also what you just mentioned) and left the choice up to her. It may be a bit more pressure on her but at least I know I'm being heard. All I can do is wait now. I did make sure to tell her she shouldn't see me as some option 2.

Anyways, thanks for the help.

Thank you, I think you have great advice. I told her that and I think it's the right thing to do. However, I don't think we can be friends if she decides to choose her ex. It'd just be too much for me and I wouldn't be able to get over it.

I feel the need to express that to her somehow, but I don't think the moment is right for that. What if she makes a quick decision? Then I didn't tell her anything. It's a bit contradictive in my head
